text:
Elena R.: Hey team — pulling together owners for the postmortem actions from last night's incident. Can folks confirm ownership + ETA or blockers? Current items I'm tracking:
- data schema migration (cust data retention)
- alerting thresholds + runbook
- fallback routing & canary policy
- customer comms draft

incident-bot: Postmortem created: https://redwood-internal/pm/postmortem-2026-03-15 (auto)

Matt K.: I can take the data schema migration. Target ETA: 2026-04-02. PR opened: `#4821` (migration + small compat shim). Blocker: need infra migration window approval (ticket `infra-mig-77`). I can do the deploy once approved.

Samir P.: I own alerting thresholds + runbook. ETA: 2026-04-06. I'll add the runbook to docs and add unit tests for the threshold logic. PR will reference `alerts/thresholds` config.

Jordan A.: I can take fallback routing & canary policy, but I'm blocked on eng-sre review for the routing policy changes (PR `#4867`). Also need a quick perf check from infra (latency on the new path). If eng-sre can't review by Fri, we should schedule a short call.

Elena R.: Thanks — noted blockers. For customer comms: can one of you draft a short summary (1-2 paragraphs) and I'll coordinate legal review? Suggest ETA for comms: 2026-04-05.

Matt K.: I'll draft the comms (shortbullets + TL;DR). Will post a first cut by EOD today. @Samir P. @Jordan A. please react if you want edits.

Samir P.: Runbook outline added: https://redwood-internal/docs/runbooks/incident-2026-03-15. I left TODOs for watch queries and alert pages.

Jordan A.: Pinged eng-sre in their channel and linked `#4867`. Also requested perf bench; infra asked for a small repro script — I'll drop that in the PR comments.

Elena R.: Consolidating final assignments and due dates. Please update PRs/docs and add a reaction when your item is complete. If you can't meet ETA, reply here with new ETA and blocker.

```
Actions (owner | due | blocker):
- Data schema migration | Matt K. | 2026-04-02 | infra migration window (`infra-mig-77`)
- Alerting thresholds + runbook | Samir P. | 2026-04-06 | none (tests in progress)
- Fallback routing & canary | Jordan A. | 2026-04-04 | eng-sre review (PR `#4867`) + perf bench
- Customer comms draft | Matt K. | 2026-04-05 | legal review
```
Elena R.: I'll check back on Monday for any ETA changes. If infra approves migration window earlier, Matt, you can move the date up. Please react with :white_check_mark: when done.

incident-bot: Reminder set — follow-up check-in scheduled 2026-03-23 15:00 UTC.
